style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal gradient #1C1F26 for hero, pain and CTA bands; light lavender-grey #F2F1F4 for infographic, comparison and trust sections

style.lightingSystem: directional studio and natural window light, cool-neutral 5000-5500K in scene shots, rim light on athletes, deep controlled shadows, clean high-key light on infographic sections
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent energetic premium fitness-training visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1C1F26, light lavender-grey #F2F1F4, pure white text #FFFFFF, one orange-red accent #E8442E and one cool blue secondary accent #2E8FE8; directional studio and natural window lighting, cool-neutral 5000-5500K in scene shots, rim light on athletes, deep controlled shadows, clean high-key light on infographic sections; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin-line icons and solid rounded label chips in a single accent color; real gym environment with matte rubber flooring and brushed steel equipment; athletes shown only as generic role figures from behind or cropped, faces never visible; fully composed frames with balanced margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible faces.
style.presentationRules: athletes appear only as generic role figures shown from behind or cropped, faces never visible; stable scale and placement across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte rubber gym flooring, brushed steel equipment, matte light-grey walls
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
